caption:
Finding the perfect line for mountain biking in Costa Rica means looking past the digital maps and following the old agricultural ridges. I spend weeks scouting these high-altitude corridors on two wheels, searching for the exact point where the cloud forest parts to reveal the valleys below. Every route I design for My Adventure Costa Rica is tested under my own tires first, ensuring the transition between demanding climbs and quiet descents feels entirely earned. It is a slow, physical way to map a country, but it is the only way to find the places that maps ignore.
